info.name: LaundryFlow API v1
info.description: The REST API of LaundryFlow, the laundry shop management and QR basket tracking system: staff (JWT, api guard) and the customer portal (JWT, customer guard). Built following the course API Master Class in Laravel: versioned at /api/v1, JSON:API-style resources, course error format.

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Staff sign-in with JWT (course L8): log in, read the current user, refresh and log out.
Staff accounts are created by the owner in Settings, so there is no public registration.

request.description:
Returns an access token. Send it as a Bearer token on every other request. Five failed
attempts a minute for the same username and IP answer 429.

Blacklists the current token (an expired one is accepted within JWT_REFRESH_TTL) and returns
a new one carrying the user's current abilities.
Blacklists the current token so it can never be used again.
Returns the staff member who owns the Bearer token, with their role and permissions.
Also allowed while a password change is pending.

item.name: Look up a scanned or typed code

request.description:
`code` is a basket label URL (…/b/{token}), a bare token, a basket number (BSK-0007) or an
order number (LF-261108-0001). A basket answers with its active order (or null when it is
available, retired, or its last order is completed); an order number answers with the order.

item.name: Branding
item.description:
White-label branding: the shop's name, logo, colors, labels and options. The public endpoint feeds
every screen before sign-in; the owner edits them in Settings > Branding & Appearance.

request.description:
No sign-in needed (the login page and the customer portal read it first). Nothing private is in
it; the contact email only when the owner chose to show it. Sends an ETag; browsers revalidate it
every time (an unchanged answer is a tiny 304), so a saved change shows at once.

Today's work for the counter: KPIs, the flow per stage, recent orders, low stock and what
needs action. Sales figures are added only for users who may see them (sales.view): staff
responses contain no money from payments.

query.description: First Manila day (Y-m-d). Defaults to 29 days ago.

request.description:
The dashboard's KPIs and charts for a Manila date range, compared with the range of the same
length just before it. Users with sales.view get the admin document; everyone else gets the
staff document, which is built without a single peso field (not hidden: never sent).

The document is not a model resource: it is the analytics envelope
{ range, compare_range, generated_at, kpis, series, table, insights }, inside ok().

Answers 200 when the API runs and its database accepts queries, and 503 when the database
cannot be reached. It never returns data from the database. Docker's health check and the
frontend's dev server call it.

request.description:
Forward one stage at a time. An admin may go back one stage with a note. Completed needs a
zero balance and frees the baskets. 409 for a skip, the same status, a balance due, a completed
order or a stale scan; 403 for a move back without orders.revert; 422 for a move back without a note.

item.name: Wash types
item.description:
How the laundry is washed, with the optional surcharge per kilo and the soaps each one uses.
Staff read them to take orders; only the owner changes them (Settings > Pricing & Usage).
Changes apply to new orders only: an order freezes its wash type surcharge when it is made.

query.description: Only active (1) or inactive (0) wash types.
